# Oceanographic Data Sources

Below is a comprehensive table of major sources of oceanographic data, categorized by type, including global databases, national/regional centers, satellite/remote sensing, in-situ networks, and specialized tools. Each entry includes the source name, a brief description, key data types, and access links.

| **Category**                     | **Source Name**                                    | **Description**                                                                 | **Key Data Types**                                                                 | **Access Link**                                                                 |
|----------------------------------|---------------------------------------------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| **Global Databases and Portals** | World Ocean Database (WOD)                        | Largest collection of quality-controlled ocean profile data, managed by NOAA NCEI. | Temperature, salinity, nutrients, oxygen, historical/modern profiles.              | [https://www.ncei.noaa.gov/products/world-ocean-database](https://www.ncei.noaa.gov/products/world-ocean-database) |
|                                  | IODE (UNESCO)                                     | Catalogue of ocean-related web sources, data systems, and metadata.             | Metadata, physical, chemical, biological data.                                     | [https://www.iode.org/](https://www.iode.org/)                                 |
|                                  | Copernicus Marine Service                         | Hindcast, forecast, and reanalysis data from satellites and in-situ sources.    | Sea level, temperature, currents, biogeochemistry.                                 | [https://marine.copernicus.eu/](https://marine.copernicus.eu/)                 |
|                                  | General Bathymetric Chart of the Oceans (GEBCO)   | Global gridded bathymetry data from ship soundings and satellite gravity.       | Bathymetry, seafloor topography.                                                  | [https://www.gebco.net/](https://www.gebco.net/)                               |
|                                  | PANGAEA                                           | Open-access publisher for Earth and ocean data.                                | Geophysics, biology, chemistry, environmental data.                                | [https://www.pangaea.de/](https://www.pangaea.de/)                             |
|                                  | EMODnet                                           | European marine data network for various oceanographic disciplines.            | Bathymetry, geology, biology, chemistry, physics, human activities.                | [https://www.emodnet.eu/](https://www.emodnet.eu/)                             |
|                                  | SeaDataNet                                        | Pan-European infrastructure for marine and ocean data management.              | In-situ, remote sensing, physical, chemical data.                                  | [https://www.seadatanet.org/](https://www.seadatanet.org/)                     |
|                                  | Ocean Biodiversity Information System (OBIS)      | Global database for marine species distribution and biodiversity.              | Species occurrences, biodiversity data.                                            | [https://obis.org/](https://obis.org/)                                         |
|                                  | Global Biodiversity Information Facility (GBIF)   | Open-access portal for biodiversity, including marine species.                 | Marine species occurrences, ecological data.                                       | [https://www.gbif.org/](https://www.gbif.org/)                                 |
|                                  | ICES Oceanography Database                        | Quality-controlled ocean data from 1877 to present, North Atlantic focus.      | Physical, chemical parameters, historical data.                                    | [https://ocean.ices.dk/](https://ocean.ices.dk/)                               |
|                                  | Ocean Data Platform (HUB Ocean)                   | Collaborative platform aggregating ocean data for research and industry.       | Various oceanographic datasets.                                                    | [https://www.oceandata.earth/](https://www.oceandata.earth/)                   |
| **National/Regional Centers**    | NOAA NCEI                                         | Archives ocean data, including former NODC datasets.                           | Physical, biological, chemical, paleoclimatology data.                             | [https://www.ncei.noaa.gov/](https://www.ncei.noaa.gov/)                       |
|                                  | British Oceanographic Data Centre (BODC)          | Manages UK marine data, including GEBCO grids.                                 | Biology, chemistry, physics, geophysics, bathymetry.                               | [https://www.bodc.ac.uk/](https://www.bodc.ac.uk/)                             |
|                                  | Integrated Ocean Observing System (IOOS)          | U.S. regional network for real-time and historical coastal data.               | Buoy, glider, coastal station data (waves, currents, temperature).                 | [https://ioos.noaa.gov/](https://ioos.noaa.gov/)                               |
|                                  | Northeast Ocean Data Portal                       | Data layers for U.S. Northeast oceans.                                         | Ecology, human use, physical oceanography.                                         | [https://www.northeastoceandata.org/](https://www.northeastoceandata.org/)     |
|                                  | SISMER (IFREMER, France)                          | French national center for oceanographic data.                                 | Physics, chemistry, geology data.                                                  | [https://www.ifremer.fr/sismer/](https://www.ifremer.fr/sismer/)               |
|                                  | BSH (Germany)                                     | German bathymetric surveys and marine research data.                           | Bathymetry, physical oceanography.                                                 | [https://www.bsh.de/](https://www.bsh.de/)                                     |
|                                  | BGR (Germany)                                     | Geological and geophysical marine data.                                        | Seismic, geophysical survey data.                                                  | [https://www.bgr.bund.de/](https://www.bgr.bund.de/)                           |
|                                  | VLIZ (Flanders Marine Institute, Belgium)         | Data systems for North Sea and global marine research.                         | Physical, biological, chemical data.                                               | [https://www.vliz.be/](https://www.vliz.be/)                                   |
|                                  | INCOIS (India)                                    | Indian ocean data and forecast services.                                       | Ocean observations, forecasts, physical data.                                      | [https://www.incois.gov.in/](https://www.incois.gov.in/)                       |
| **Satellite/Remote Sensing**     | NASA Earthdata                                    | Ocean data from Earth-observing satellites.                                    | Sea surface temperature, salinity, winds, chlorophyll.                             | [https://earthdata.nasa.gov/](https://earthdata.nasa.gov/)                     |
|                                  | NOAA NESDIS                                       | Satellite-derived ocean data for monitoring and modeling.                      | Ocean color, sea surface temperature, weather-related data.                        | [https://www.nesdis.noaa.gov/](https://www.nesdis.noaa.gov/)                   |
|                                  | NOAA CoastWatch                                   | Satellite data products for coastal and ocean environments.                    | Ocean color, sea surface temperature, currents.                                    | [https://coastwatch.noaa.gov/](https://coastwatch.noaa.gov/)                   |
|                                  | USGS/Sentinel Image Viewer                        | Tools for viewing Earth observation imagery, including ocean surfaces.         | Satellite imagery, ocean surface data.                                             | [https://earthexplorer.usgs.gov/](https://earthexplorer.usgs.gov/)             |
| **In-Situ Observation Networks** | National Data Buoy Center (NDBC)                  | Real-time data from moored buoys and coastal stations.                         | Waves, winds, temperature, currents.                                               | [https://www.ndbc.noaa.gov/](https://www.ndbc.noaa.gov/)                       |
|                                  | Global Temperature-Salinity Profile Program (GTSPP) | Near-real-time and delayed-mode ocean profiles.                              | Temperature, salinity, velocity (ships, buoys, Argo).                              | [https://www.ncei.noaa.gov/products/gtspp](https://www.ncei.noaa.gov/products/gtspp) |
|                                  | Argo (via Argovis)                                | Global array of profiling floats with visualization tools.                     | Temperature, salinity, velocity.                                                   | [https://argovis.colorado.edu/](https://argovis.colorado.edu/)                 |
|                                  | Ocean Observatories Initiative (OOI)              | Real-time and archived data from cabled arrays, gliders, moorings.            | Physical, chemical, biological data from key ocean sites.                          | [https://oceanobservatories.org/](https://oceanobservatories.org/)             |
|                                  | BCO-DMO                                           | NSF-funded repository for biological and chemical ocean data.                 | Biological, chemical data from research projects.                                  | [https://www.bco-dmo.org/](https://www.bco-dmo.org/)                           |
|                                  | CCHDO                                             | High-quality hydrographic data, including carbon and tracers.                  | Hydrography, carbon, tracer data from cruises.                                     | [https://cchdo.ucsd.edu/](https://cchdo.ucsd.edu/)                             |
|                                  | Marine Geoscience Data System (MGDS)              | Geophysical data from marine research.                                         | Multibeam bathymetry, seismics, sub-bottom profiles.                               | [https://www.marine-geo.org/](https://www.marine-geo.org/)                     |
|                                  | Hawaii Mapping Research Group (HMRG)              | Multibeam bathymetry and sonar data from Pacific surveys.                      | Bathymetry, sonar data.                                                            | [https://www.soest.hawaii.edu/HMRG/](https://www.soest.hawaii.edu/HMRG/)       |
|                                  | EU-SeaSED                                         | Catalogue of seafloor samples, seismic, and sonar data (Europe).              | Seafloor samples, seismic, sonar data.                                             | [https://www.geo-seas.eu/](https://www.geo-seas.eu/)                           |
| **Specialized Tools**            | NOAA Ocean Color Viewer                           | Tool for viewing satellite-derived ocean color data.                           | Chlorophyll concentrations, ocean color.                                           | [https://www.star.nesdis.noaa.gov/socd/mecb/color/](https://www.star.nesdis.noaa.gov/socd/mecb/color/) |
|                                  | Global Tagging of Pelagic Predators (GTOPP)       | Tracks marine animal movements for ecological studies.                         | Animal movement, ecological data.                                                  | [https://gtopp.org/](https://gtopp.org/)                                       |
|                                  | eOceans App                                       | Citizen science tool for logging ocean observations.                           | Community-sourced ocean observations.                                              | [https://www.eoceans.app/](https://www.eoceans.app/)                           |
|                                  | Open Earth                                        | Community-driven tools for marine data analysis and modeling.                  | Various oceanographic datasets and tools.                                          | [https://open-earth.org/](https://open-earth.org/)                             |
| **Sample/General Repositories**  | Index to Marine and Lacustrine Geological Samples (IMLGS) | Database of seafloor and lakebed samples.                             | Geological samples, sediment data.                                                 | [https://www.ngdc.noaa.gov/mgg/curator/](https://www.ngdc.noaa.gov/mgg/curator/) |
|                                  | Zenodo                                            | Open repository for research data, including oceanographic datasets.           | Various oceanographic research data.                                               | [https://zenodo.org/](https://zenodo.org/)                                     |
|                                  | re3data                                           | Registry of research data repositories for discovering ocean datasets.         | Metadata, links to oceanographic repositories.                                     | [https://www.re3data.org/](https://www.re3data.org/)                           |
|                                  | UNEP SHELF Programme OSDS                         | Global inventory for continental shelf geophysical and geological data.       | Geophysical, geological data for shelf studies.                                    | [https://www.unep.org/](https://www.unep.org/)                                 |

## Notes

- **Access**: Most sources are publicly accessible, but some may require registration or specific permissions. Check individual websites for details.
- **Data Types**: Vary widely; contact specific repositories for detailed metadata or niche datasets (e.g., real-time currents, paleoceanography).
- **Additional Sources**: For regional or specialized data (e.g., COSYNA for North Sea, SHOM for French tides), explore portals like IODE or re3data.
